translations.web: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
translations.bsb: He who keeps a commandment preserves his soul, but he who is careless in his ways will die.
translations.kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
translations.asv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; But he that is careless of his ways shall die.
